description: This source file defines an abstract class 'XBitmapEncoder' and its sealed derived class 'XPngBitmapEncoder' within the PdfSharp.Drawing namespace. It provides functionality to encode bitmap images into specific formats, primarily PNG, with platform-specific code sections based on compilation symbols (GDI, WPF, WUI).

classes.name: XBitmapEncoder
classes.description: Abstract base class providing functionality to save bitmap images in a specified format. It includes properties for the source image and an abstract Save method that must be implemented by subclasses.

classes.name: XPngBitmapEncoder
classes.description: Sealed class that derives from XBitmapEncoder, implementing PNG encoding functionality. It overrides the Save method to save the image as PNG format, with platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: XBitmapEncoder.GetPngEncoder
methods.description: Static method that returns a new instance of the PNG image encoder.

methods.name: XPngBitmapEncoder.Save
methods.description: Overrides the abstract Save method to encode and save the image in PNG format to the provided stream.
